title: Mixed Event — Beyond The Dream of That Day — Episode4 How To Present My Feelings

meta.Event: Beyond The Dream of That Day
meta.Episode: Episode4 — How To Present My Feelings
meta.Event Outline: After putting on a successful solo show, MORE MORE JUMP! starts thinking about their next goal. During that time, they're offered a chance to appear on TV. Everyone is excited to hear the news, except Haruka, who doesn't quite share in their optimism...

rows.Line: Haruka's Room

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Wow...
Today's bath salts smell so nice.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Still, us appearing on TV...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I gave it a lot of thought while taking my bath, but I still couldn't reach a decision.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (The others said that they “understand” how I feel... And yet, they're all for it.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Now that you mention it...
I remember this one time when they took one of my quips and edited it to make it look like I was bad-mouthing this actor that appeared with us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Those things do actually happen...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Performing at the Dome means filling an enormous number of seats. And I believe appearing on TV will ultimately help us do that...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (However, there's a possibility that who we are or what we believe will become warped. Not only that...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That definitely makes for a good headline, but the article itself was a bit fluffed up...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Despite being a short article, it had some inconsistencies.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (We're not going to be able to avoid things like that if we want to keep doing more as idols...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Especially since the three of us were once a part of bigger groups, some are likely going to make fun of us for trying to do things on our own.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: By appearing on TV, there's also a chance that we'll end up disappointing all those who've been supporting us up until now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (On the other hand, some people may become our fans after seeing us on TV...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But given the risk of possibly having our image twisted and disappointing our fans... Is it really worth it?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Th-Th-This is so cool...!
We might get to be on TV...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'd like to accept as well!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I think the benefits of us appearing on TV outweigh the costs, so I'm in favor of accepting this offer.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Am I overthinking this...?
I did plenty of TV appearances when I was still with ASRUN, and I usually had a lot of fun...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (The others are incredibly optimistic about this, so maybe if we gave one appearance a try...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
No, that's not good enough.
Regardless of whether or not we make a successful appearance, I won't feel satisfied.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (The others even said that there's no point in proceeding with this unless I agree... So, I want to first flesh out how I really feel about this offer.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But that may be a little hard on my own. I'd really like to get an objective second opinion right about now...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wait, that's it...!
bgm_area00002
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Can I ask you all for a bit of your time?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hm? Haruka?
What are you doing here at this time?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I've been having trouble coming up with an answer to something on my own. So, I'd like to ask all of you for your opinions...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The thing is...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, that's wonderful...!
You girls have set your sights on performing at the Dome!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
It is a wonderful dream.
That only makes me more excited about your future.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But we'll need to find an answer to your question before you can feel happy about that, yes...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: About you girls making that TV appearance, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, Haruka, you're worried that MMJ's image and message might not come across the way you want it to and possibly upset your fans if you appear on TV...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes... I know that shows are edited in a way to be entertaining, which is fine since I also like programs that are fun to watch...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I'm worried that what we want to convey is going to fall victim to that process. I'm concerned that we'll appear vain or conceited, which will disappoint all of our fans...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But that's not destined to happen just because I think it might, right...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, I'm starting to wonder why I'm considering not making this appearance.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I suppose I'm just worried about us not having the backup and protection of an agency. Is that why I'm not prepared to go on TV yet?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I don't think so...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Me neither. Especially considering how much you care about your fans, Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We're always doing everything we can to spread hope to our fans... But they've also given us so much.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: MORE MORE JUMP! fans must be so happy knowing that they get to be there for such thoughtful idols.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. There's no need to be embarrassed by that. Personally, as your fan, I can't help but fall further in love with you, Haruka♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: H-Hey, quit teasing me.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehehe.
That's what makes you so great, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: As your fan, I want to say, “Don't worry.”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I've become very familiar with you girls.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Including the hope and warmth you wish to spread to others.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And those things mean quite a lot to me...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, a TV appearance isn't going to easily change how I feel about all of you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We'll never stop being your fans because we know what MORE MORE JUMP! is really about.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Now that you mention it...
I remember this one time when they took one of my quips and edited it to make it look like I was bad-mouthing this actor that appeared with us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What?! No way!
Was everything okay after that?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, things got pretty hectic after it aired. Some of that actor's fans still bring it up from time to time...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But my fans claimed, “Airi would never say stuff like that,” which helped keep things from really getting out of hand.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, don't worry. I'm sure everything will be fine. Regardless of the kind of television program you girls appear on, we won't get disappointed or stop being your fans.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I want more and more people to learn about the group we all love! I want more and more people to fall in love with MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I want you girls to spread more hope and warmth to others.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Which I believe you'll have no problem doing when you're in front of those cameras.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Right♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I agree...
You girls are who you are. Nothing is going to change that.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah!
As long as your intentions don't change, everyone will get your message!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes... Not only that, I'm sure that your fans are also looking forward to having your TV appearance lead to more people learning about you girls.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
True...
The ones who sent us those letters will probably be very happy.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you all very much.
You've given me quite a bit of encouragement.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: However, Haruka, the final decision rests with you and your group, so it's okay for you to take your time with this.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: While you do, it may be good to take a hard look at what you're feeling...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: At what I'm feeling?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. You girls put on a successful solo show and have put forth a fantastic goal for yourselves. As a result, you're at a crossroads so to speak.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's not uncommon to lose sight of what means most to you... Why you decided to become an idol in the first place or how you felt back then...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, now might not be a bad time to look back on all that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You might be right...
Thank you. I think I'll do just that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We'll be looking forward to seeing what MORE MORE JUMP! has in store for us.
